featureDefinitions.previous_month_spend: Total purchase spend in month M-1 (most recent complete month)
featureDefinitions.spend_2_months_ago: Total purchase spend in month M-2
featureDefinitions.spend_3_months_ago: Total purchase spend in month M-3
featureDefinitions.avg_3_month_spend: Arithmetic mean of previous_month_spend, spend_2_months_ago, spend_3_months_ago
featureDefinitions.purchase_count: Count of all purchase records in M-1
featureDefinitions.online_purchase_ratio: Fraction of M-1 purchases with purchaseType == 'ONLINE' (0.0 to 1.0)
featureDefinitions.electronics_spend: Sum of M-1 spend where category == 'Electronics'
featureDefinitions.fashion_spend: Sum of M-1 spend where category == 'Fashion'
featureDefinitions.food_spend: Sum of M-1 spend where category in ['Food & Beverages', 'Food & Groceries']
featureDefinitions.home_spend: Sum of M-1 spend where category in ['Home Appliances', 'Furniture']
featureDefinitions.other_spend: Sum of M-1 spend in all remaining categories
